name: labnotebook-app
description: Standalone Easylab Lab Notebook desktop and PWA worktree.
author: Meghamsh Teja Konda

scripts.standalone:dev: set EASYLAB_LABNOTE_DEV=1&& concurrently "npm --prefix web run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && electron desktop/main.cjs"
scripts.standalone:build: npm --prefix web run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json
